estimator.name: nsight_pp0_first_alloc_extend_marker

start.selection: Consume the logged FCFS request cached/new-token ledger across PP0 batches; for each request, select the device-0 alloc_extend marker with the same ordinal as its first PP0 batch.

excluded_intervals: Client-side and pre-server wait before SGLang receives the request.
SGLang internal queue time from queue admission through scheduler dequeue.
CPU time from scheduler dequeue/forward_entry to the first rank-0 GPU marker.
estimator.token_ready_end: SGLang request_finished_ts; every measured request generated exactly one token.
estimator.mapping_rule: Measured request IDs are exact logged FCFS ordinals 0 through 599. Mode A contributes 89,984 cached plus 10,048 scheduler-padded new tokens; mode B contributes 90,048 cached plus 9,984 scheduler-padded new tokens. Greedy ledger consumption maps each request to its first of 185 PP0 batches and the one-to-one device-0 GPU marker.
estimator.queue_exclusion: Client/pre-server wait and SGLang's internal wait queue are excluded.

bias_and_uncertainty.direction: The GPU marker occurs after unrecorded CPU forward_entry, so this marker-defined service interval slightly underestimates CPU-dequeue-to-token service TTFT.
bias_and_uncertainty.interpretation: The preceding PP0 result releases PP4 scheduler capacity but is not the missing forward_entry timestamp. Its result-to-marker distribution is an observed alignment scale, not a hard error bound.

primary.definition: Client eof_epoch_ns lies inside the report's inclusive stable scheduler window; this selects request ordinals 36 through 597.

full_run.definition: All 600 successful measured requests in exact logged FCFS order, including pipeline startup and drain.

scheduler.pipeline_identity: For PP0 result rows j=5..180, 600 minus logged queue[j] equals cumulative requests admitted through batch j+3.
